# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Password sign-in

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com (Production)

Sign in with a neurokaraoke.com username and password. Use this when the client has a keyboard and the user is comfortable typing their password into it.

Every sign-in flow ends with a JWT that is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on later requests. Tokens are not refreshed, so sign in again when a request returns `401`. Store tokens in the platform's secure storage and never log them.

### `POST /api/auth/login` — Sign in with username and password

Auth: none

Validates the username and password and returns a bearer token. Usernames are case-insensitive. Returns `400` when the request is malformed and `401` when the credentials are wrong or the account is locked. Requests are rate limited per client.

Request body `application/json`:

```ts
{
  username: string  // min length: 3
  password: string  // min length: 6
}
```

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  token: string | null
}
```
